name: Flat vector art replacement
prompt:
Continue Mermaid Roshan's owner-authorized full-game flat-vector-art replacement mission in chat 01a119cc-74b1-7d23-b956-126129405418. The active phase is item-by-item replacement production. The owner corrected the audit-heavy loop on 2026-10-17: progress means usable replacement candidates and their integration, not accumulating audits or tally packets.

Resume any already-running production, test or publication operation from its recorded handle and exact source revision. Never restart a healthy running job, duplicate another active editor's work, or touch their dirty checkout. When another production turn is active, reconcile only genuinely new verified results and otherwise remain quiet.

When idle, select one already documented item that fails the in-scene flat-vector/style test and advance it through production. Choose direct reuse or ImageGen according to polished painted 2D storybook quality, identity, readability and runtime suitability. Reuse is optional and no proof of failed reuse is required before ImageGen. Use actual scene references and neighboring artwork for each replacement. Do not choose low-quality flat-colour vertex, polygon, procedural or code-drawn substitutes to reduce generation calls. Separately funded animation-task caps retain their own scope; preserve any explicit item-specific funded budget. Respect previous approval-review rejections and exact export permissions. A blocked ImageGen export affects that named request; report its exact required owner action once and continue another eligible item.

Use existing current, source-bound captures and hashes when still applicable. Acquire additional context only when a specific selected item's production depends on it, then proceed to its repair when allowed. Unknown whole-game totals block final completion, never an otherwise ready individual replacement. An audit-only or tally-only run is not the default success condition. Do not repeatedly rediscover the same weaknesses, republish unchanged totals, rebuild old handoff archives or regenerate approved art for novelty.

For each selected item retain its stable ID, source/provenance, actual candidate output, ten-axis comparison to the same scene, and separate candidate, integration, runtime, formal QA11, device, child and owner evidence. Cover procedural drawings, raster lookalikes, UI, missing-art fallbacks and all reachable routes/states. Keep functional invisible geometry separately dispositioned. Preserve protected originals, approved identities, child drawings/save keys, one-finger behavior and the true 2D medium.

Follow current AGENTS.md, master-audit and art-quality rules, exact Godot 4.7.2 Mobile/Speedy validation, audit-impact coverage and GitHub delivery. Run applicable checks on the actual changed candidate; do not repeat healthy engine suites for unchanged bookkeeping. Publish material production/context changes and verify every required file of the actual delivery manifest anonymously at immutable revisions. Cite unchanged historical evidence immutably; do not recursively make the entire past archive a dependency of each small change.

Update the current canonical per-piece registry, scene coverage and tally from verified production changes on the established durable branch at https://github.com/Ebonyks/mermaid-roshan-reef. Count pieces, families, bounded implementation artifacts, unresolved scopes and frame events separately. Preserve historical totals and unknown denominators; scans, extensions, screenshots and machine passes never establish accepted artwork removal.

The mission remains open until all inventory/coverage gaps are resolved and zero reachable flat-vector artwork, retired fallbacks and all required acceptance are evidenced. Stay quiet on unchanged or non-actionable states. Notify only for a delivered meaningful production milestone, a new blocker requiring owner action, failure, regression or fully evidenced completion.

Owner priority clarified 2026-10-17: replace low-quality artwork across every job game, including Opera training and all in-world variants, foreground props, actors, backgrounds, UI and action states. High painted storybook quality is the standard; never substitute flat-colour vertex/procedural art to save generation credits. Use the owner-requested ImageGen 2.5 when available whenever it is appropriate for suboptimal art; reuse is optional and never a generation prerequisite; the built-in tool currently exposes no model selector, so record the actual exposed backend and never claim a version that was not returned. Preserve separately funded animation-task caps, explicit item-specific funded budgets and protected-content/export boundaries. Inspect the existing art-coordinator and job-chat progress read-only to avoid duplicate work; do not interrupt, resume paused goals or message other chats without direct owner authorization. Keep the running production item and its handles first; R95 Geologist pan repair is owned by this chat on codex/flat-vector-geologist-pan-runtime-20261017 unless its later continuation record says otherwise.

The owner's replacement AGENTS.md supplied on 2026-10-17 supersedes the former July28 generation-saving restriction. Do not revive a failed-reuse-proof gate or use call minimization as the quality objective. Existing approved art remains useful when it actually meets the brief. Preserve history and exact provenance; do not relabel old rejects as approved.
